::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Envelope postmarked Winchester 26 March 1853 and Plympton 27 March 1853  
**Manuscript:** MS (envelope) West Devon Record Office Acc No 308
:::

[Only the envelope seems to survive of this letter;  it is postmarked Winchester 26 March 1853 and Plympton 27 March 1853, endorsed ‘Coleridge’ with writing inside the flap ‘Your letter is come, many thanks, We went to see about the ?cousingas [another inserted illegible word] the woman was out but is to call. The Herb is soon to be begun.’  It perhaps refers to the publication of *[The Herb of the Field](cmy_books/cmybook_17.qmd)* (1853)]
